Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Spend ten minutes and roll Reason to learn a danger on a course of action you propose. Better results reveal a way to lessen it or a warning sign.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and one visible willing ally within 3 squares.
Type
Skill / Defense / Movement

Move up to 3 squares toward the ally without provoking. If you end adjacent, you and the ally gain 1 Boon to defenses until the end of your next turn while you remain adjacent.
